high_energy_sakuga.visual_environment: Daytime azure sky with golden sunbeams or stormy thunderclouds
choreography: Shot 1 (Build): Hand to katana hilt, hair whipping in slipstream, thumb pops tsuba guard open with golden star sparkle
Shot 2 (Climax): High-velocity cross-screen dash, speedlines burst across 9:16 vertical frame, sweeping golden-cyan plasma slash arc, screen shake, shockwave particles
Shot 3 (Resolve): Low-angle heroic stance facing camera, drawn steel blade angled in foreground, blinding 8-point sunburst flare reflecting off blade edge

mellow_peace_ghibli.visual_environment: Towering summer cumulus clouds, lush emerald hills, floating sakura cherry blossoms
choreography: Shot 1 (Ambiance): Gentle wind blowing haori robes and long layered fringe hair, clouds billowing slowly
Shot 2 (Soul): Slow camera push-in on hero gaze, light breeze drifting petals across the frame
Shot 3 (Reflection): Peaceful horizon gaze, soft golden hour sun flare with specular rim light

mystic_ancient_soul.visual_environment: Ancient red Torii gate arch, twilight mountain ridge, rising spiritual fireflies/embers
choreography: Shot 1 (Spiritual): Hero standing before ancient Torii gate, subtle rhythmic breathing cel animation
Shot 2 (Ascent): Floating glowing spiritual wisps swirling around the katana hilt
Shot 3 (Enlightenment): Blade drawn gently, radiant turquoise/amber aura emitting from the steel
